DeepSeek Harness (DSH)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it provides"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Seven official Wind Streamable HTTP MCP domains are connected through DSH's
own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"mcp-client` and exposed as native tools:
`wind_stock`, `wind_fund`, `wind_index`, `wind_bond`, `wind"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"_docs`,
`wind_economic`, and `wind_analytics`.
- `wind_alice` invokes Wind Alice's professional fina"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ncial-analysis workflows,
including fact checking, company one-pagers, earnings reviews, screening,
"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"macro, bond, credit, fund, market-sizing, and comparable-company analysis.
- Two runtime Skills teac"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"h the agent how to route requests without putting an
API key or shell commands into the prompt.
- A "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"Settings namespace declares `WIND_API_KEY` as a DSH credential reference."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why a plugin is needed"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"DSH intentionally removes credential-shaped environment variables from
model-visible shell processes"},{"id":"p8s2","text":". Putting `WIND_API_KEY` in the host environment
therefore does not make the official Wind CLI avail"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"able to an Agent's Bash
tool—and copying the key into the workspace would defeat the boundary."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"This plugin resolves the credential inside the trusted host process. Wind MCP
traffic passes through"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" a random, loopback-only adapter that injects the Bearer
token and then delegates protocol handling "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"and tool registration to DSH's MCP
client. Alice resolves the same credential per operation. The key"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" is never
returned to the model, stored in plugin configuration, or exposed to ordinary
Bash command"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"s never
returned to the model, stored in plugin configuration, or exposed to ordinary
Bash commands."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"DSH `0.1.0-rc.8` or newer is recommended."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Restart the profile after installation. Install into another profile by
replacing `web` with that pr"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"rofile after installation. Install into another profile by
replacing `web` with that profile's name."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Configure"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Create a Wind AIFin API key at the
Wind developer portal, then
store it as the DSH credential refere"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"nce `WIND_API_KEY` using the Credentials
page. A deployment may instead provide `WIND_API_KEY` in th"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"e trusted DSH launch
environment."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Do not put the key in a workspace file, Skill file, prompt, MCP headers in
`cordis.patch.yml`, or a "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"model-visible shell profile."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Tool names"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"MCP tools follow DSH's standard qualified naming convention:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Domain | Prefix |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Stocks | `mcp__wind_stock__` |
| Funds and ETFs | `mcp__wind_fund__` |
| Indices and sectors | `mc"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"p__wind_index__` |
| Bonds | `mcp__wind_bond__` |
| Filings and financial news | `mcp__wind_docs__` "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"|
| Macro and industry indicators | `mcp__wind_economic__` |
| Cross-asset analytics | `mcp__wind_an"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"d industry indicators | `mcp__wind_economic__` |
| Cross-asset analytics | `mcp__wind_analytics__` |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Wind Alice is exposed as `wind_alice` and accepts a prompt plus an optional
professional workflow na"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"d Alice is exposed as `wind_alice` and accepts a prompt plus an optional
professional workflow name."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Security and data flow"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- The credential adapter listens only on `127.0.0.1` and uses an unguessable
per-process route.
- Th"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"e adapter accepts only the seven fixed Wind endpoints; users cannot turn it
into a general authentic"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ated proxy.
- Credentials are resolved for each request and are not cached in files.
- Financial req"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"uests and selected context are sent to Wind's service. Review
Wind's service terms before sending co"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"nfidential information.
- This plugin has no install script and does not bundle or redistribute Wind"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"'s
official Skills repository."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"In version `0.1.0`, Alice's final textual/data artifact is returned to the
Agent; Alice-generated do"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"wnloadable files are not automatically copied into the
DSH workspace."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"See SECURITY.md for vulnerability reporting and the trust
